messages.snippet: Marisa, Working through the portfolio for our FTO report. Three queries on the patent schedule: (1)
messages.subject: Project Vertex - patent schedule queries
messages.plaintextBody:
Marisa,

Working through the portfolio for our FTO report. Three queries on the patent schedule: (1) please confirm the grant status of CBX-VTX-006 in CN - the register shows pending; (2) can you confirm the US renewal position on CBX-VTX-009; and (3) for the two families being assigned (013/014), please confirm there are no inventorship disputes outstanding. A short call may be quickest.

Thanks,
Tom Gallagher
Whitfield Carter LLP

messages.snippet: Tom, (1) CBX-VTX-006 CN is still pending - examination report expected Q4. (2) The US renewal on 009
messages.subject: RE: Project Vertex - patent schedule queries
messages.plaintextBody:
Tom,

(1) CBX-VTX-006 CN is still pending - examination report expected Q4. (2) The US renewal on 009 was paid in the grace period in January with a surcharge; it's in force - I'll send the receipt for your tab 9. (3) No inventorship disputes on 013/014; both inventors assigned to Calbryn on joining. I'll get the updated schedule over to you.

Marisa
